topic: GitHub to Vercel Repository Binding Evaluation

binding_attempt.cli_error: Failed to connect lhrsm/barbex to project. Make sure there aren't any typos and that you have access to the repository if it's private.

root_cause: The GitHub Vercel App integration lacks OAuth/access permissions for the private repository lhrsm/barbex under team startup-dc20.
required_action: Operator must install/configure the Vercel GitHub App for repository lhrsm/barbex via GitHub Settings or Vercel Dashboard (Project Settings -> Git -> Connect Git Repository).
